activities.name: Kota Tua Heritage Walk
activities.description: Wander Fatahillah Square and its ring of 18th-century Dutch colonial buildings — the former Batavia town hall, the old courthouse, and the Portuguese cannon café. Oldest preserved colonial quarter in Southeast Asia.

activities.name: Museum Sejarah Jakarta
activities.description: Jakarta History Museum inside the 1710 Batavia City Hall. Dutch colonial artefacts, old maps of Batavia, and the famous dungeons beneath the building. Tue–Sun 09:00–15:00.

activities.name: Bundaran HI City Walk
activities.description: Walk the Sudirman–Thamrin corridor from Bundaran HI to the National Monument. The Selamat Datang sculpture in the roundabout marks Jakarta's symbolic centre — surround yourself with the SCBD skyline at sunset.

activities.name: Taman Suropati Morning Walk
activities.description: A 1920s colonial park in the heart of Menteng, ringed by embassies and Dutch art-deco mansions. Early morning joggers and chess players give it real Jakarta neighbourhood character.

activities.name: Ancol Bay City Waterfront
activities.description: Jakarta's largest waterfront leisure complex. Dunia Fantasi theme park, Ocean Dream Samudra aquarium, glamping cabins on the beach, and a 2km esplanade facing the Java Sea. Best at dusk.

activities.name: Kemang Art & Café District
activities.description: South Jakarta's expat and creative hub. Galleries, independent concept stores, and boutique cafés packed into a leafy residential grid. Jalan Kemang Raya is the main strip; best explored on foot.

activities.name: Museum Nasional Indonesia
activities.description: The National Museum — 'The Elephant Building' — holds 190,000 artefacts covering the full breadth of Indonesian civilisation: Hindu-Buddhist bronzes, batik, weapons, ceramics, and ethnographic collections. Tue–Sun.

activities.name: Sate Khas Senayan
activities.description: Jakarta's most celebrated satay restaurant since 1974. Tender skewers of beef, chicken, and lamb served with sweet soy peanut sauce, lontong rice cake, and pickled shallots. Queue expected at lunch.

activities.name: Batagor and Siomay Lunch
activities.description: Jakarta's street-food obsession: fried fish dumplings (batagor) and steamed pork/fish dumplings (siomay) served with peanut sauce and lime. Find the best carts around Pasar Santa and Blok M.

activities.name: Mie Gacoan Spicy Noodles
activities.description: Indonesia's viral spicy noodle chain, born in Malang but now all over Jakarta. Order the Mie Hompimpa level 5 if you want the full challenge — silky noodles in a blazing red broth with crispy shallots.

activities.name: Hotel Indonesia Kempinski
activities.description: Jakarta's original grand hotel, opened in 1962 by Sukarno. Towers over Bundaran HI with 289 rooms, two pools, and the Signatures Restaurant offering Indonesian fine dining. Directly on the roundabout.

activities.name: The Ritz-Carlton Pacific Place
activities.description: SCBD tower hotel with panoramic views across the Jakarta skyline. 394 rooms, a 25m rooftop pool, and the Henshin rooftop restaurant/bar on the 68th floor. Best sunset views in the city.

activities.name: Henshin Rooftop Bar
activities.description: The highest rooftop bar in Jakarta — 68 floors above SCBD. Japanese-fusion menu and craft cocktails with an unobstructed 360° view of the Jakarta skyline after dark. Reservations essential.

activities.name: Kota Tua Night Market
activities.description: Fatahillah Square transforms after dark: food stalls, bicycle rental with light rigs, street performers, and the dramatic flood-lit colonial facades. Packed on weekends — best atmosphere in the city after sunset.

activities.name: Grand Indonesia Shopping
activities.description: Jakarta's premier mall: 150,000 sqm connecting two towers around Bundaran HI. Zara, H&M, international brands, and the largest supermarket in central Jakarta. Attached to Hotel Indonesia Kempinski.

activities.name: Pasar Baru Colonial Market
activities.description: Jakarta's oldest shopping street (1820s), still selling textiles, ready-to-wear, and traditional goods. The crumbling Dutch-era shophouses give it character no mall can replicate. Chinese-Indonesian tailors abound.

activities.name: Pulau Seribu Day Trip
activities.description: Take a fast boat from Ancol marina to the Thousand Islands (Pulau Seribu). Pulau Tidung and Pulau Pari are closest — clear water, coral snorkelling, and white sand beaches 1.5h from Jakarta's city centre.

activities.name: Kalon Wellness & Spa
activities.description: Traditional Javanese massage therapy in Kemang. Signature treatments use volcanic stone, coconut oil, and lulur body scrub — the same ritual used at the Yogyakarta royal court. 90min from Rp350,000.

activities.name: ISTORA Senayan
activities.description: Indoor arena adjacent to the GBK complex — home of Indonesian badminton (the nation's Olympic obsession). Check the schedule for Thomas/Uber Cup qualifying matches and local league games.

activities.name: Museum Tekstil Jakarta
activities.description: Indonesia's finest batik collection — over 1,000 batik cloths from every province. The museum also runs batik-making workshops where visitors can stamp and wax their own cloth to take home. Thu–Sun.
